✳ Your desktop, within reach

Ctrl + Alt + Space That’s all it takes to get started.

A calmer way to find things

Less hunting.
More doing.

Scout searches the places you already use and shows local results as you type. A clear result is always your choice to open.

1

Press the shortcut

Bring up Scout from anywhere on your desktop.

2

Type what you remember

A filename, an app, a folder, or a phrase like “latest PDF in downloads.”

3

Choose what opens

Preview, reveal, copy a path, or open the result with Enter.

Built for the way you work

More than an app launcher.

Jump between apps, files, links, and saved workspaces without breaking focus. Need a few things at once? Scout lets you review a group before opening it.

  • Find files by name, type, folder, and date
  • Preview a file before opening it
  • Save groups as workspaces

Yours, on your PC

Your search stays local.

Scout indexes file names and metadata on your computer. It doesn’t index document contents. Browser history is off until you choose to include it.

✓

Local by default

Your index, pins, workspaces, and launch history stay on your device.

✓

AI is optional

Set up local AI if you want it. Setup downloads a separate runtime and model; inference then runs on your PC.

✓

You stay in control

Scout never opens a result just because a search or model suggested it.

Ready when you are

A better way back to your work.

Download the ZIP, extract it, and run Scout.exe. Press Ctrl + Alt + Space whenever you need it.
